items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Gene would come in and play with us occasionally, Gene Ammons. Yeah, he worked with us at times.

ctx.x: Well, but, wouldn't some of that creep into your band, with the younger musicians wanting to play in that way?

Yeah, we had the freedom and things, but we never did relinquish that beat. We didn't get away from that. We always kept that thing going. And we had plenty -- what's her name played with us, not at the Delisa, but at the Regal, Gene Ammons.
